description: This file defines a Java interface named TaxClassService that extends a generic service interface for managing TaxClass entities. It provides methods to list tax classes by store and retrieve tax classes by code, within the context of a merchant store.

classes.name: TaxClassService
classes.description: A Java interface extending a generic service for TaxClass entities, providing methods for listing and retrieving tax classes within a merchant store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass based on its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code within the context of a specific MerchantStore.
